content: स्वामिन् {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [स्व-अस्त्यर्थे मिनि दीर्घः] Possessing proprietory rights. --{%m.%} .²1 A proprietor, an owner. .²2 A lord, master; रघुस्वामिनः सच्चरित्रम् <ls>Vikr. 18. 107</ls>. .²4 A sovereign, king, monarch. .²5 A husband. .²6 A spiritual preceptor. .²7 A learned Brāhmaṇa, an ascetic or religious man of the highest order; (in this sense usually added to proper names). .²8 An epithet of Kārtikeya. .²9 Of Viṣṇu. .²10 Of Śiva. .²11 Of the sage Vātsyāyana. .²12 Of Garuḍa. .²13 The sacrificer, the owner (at a याग); योऽर्थी स्वत्यागेन ऋत्विजः परिक्रीणीते, यश्च स्वं प्रदेयं त्यजति स स्वामी <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 3. 21</ls>; तस्मान्न स्वामिनः प्रतिनिधिः <ab>ibid.</ab> .²14 The image or temple of a god.
